desc.en: A soft metal extracted from Holinica Ore. It's not very durable, but it's easy to find and process, making it widely used in households.
desc.ja: ホリニカ鉱石から取れる軟らかい金属。あまり耐久性が高いとは言えないが、取れる量や加工のしやすさから、一般家庭にまで広まっている

desc.en: Effect: Raises item's effect by equipment frames x 4％.
desc.ja: 効果：装備枠の大きさ×４％アイテムの効果が上昇する

desc.en: Effect: There is a 25％ chance not to consume use count of the item during battle, but it will consume MP instead.
desc.ja: 効果：戦闘中、２５％の確率で使用回数が減らなくなるが、ＭＰを消費する

desc.en: Effect: The item is completely used up in a single use during battle, but its power increases by use count x 2％.
desc.ja: 効果：戦闘中、１回でアイテムを使い切る代わりに、使用回数×２％威力が増加する
